title: Northgate Card Benefits at Northgate — Cardholder Discount, Shipping and Return Window Terms
content:
This is the single statement of the **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** benefits that apply to Northgate purchases.

## Cardholder discount

- The cardholder discount of the card's discount percentage is taken at checkout on each eligible line paid with the card, and the purchase posts net of it.
- The cardholder discount applies only when the card account is in active status at the time of purchase, as the system record of the card account shows it.
- The discount base is the line price after item promotions, price matches and price adjustments, before Northgate Cash, gift cards and tax; the discount is rounded half up to the cent per line.
- It never applies to the purchase types the card excludes (gift cards, prescriptions, membership fees, protection plans and marketplace seller-fulfilled items), and it applies to Northgate Marketplace items only when they are Fulfilled by Northgate.
- **Stacking:** the discount is applied last, on the line price left after every other price reduction, so it never compounds with or is applied before another discount; membership benefits only affect delivery fees and do not interact with it.

Hypothetical worked line on a card with a 5% discount: a line priced 80.00 with a 10.00 item promotion has a discount base of 70.00; the discount is 3.50 and the line posts at 66.50. A gift card or a Marketplace seller-fulfilled item on the same order gets no discount.

## Shipping

Where the card carries free standard shipping, standard shipping on Ship to Home orders paid with the card is free regardless of size, and where that and a membership benefit both waive the same fee the fee is waived once.

## Return window and refunds

Items bought with the card get the card's extra return days added to the standard return window of the item. A refund for a returned line credits the amount actually paid for that line, net of the discount, back to the card.

Hypothetical illustration: the 66.50 line above, returned, credits 66.50 back to the card, not 70.00 or 80.00.

| Account status at the time of purchase | Cardholder discount |
|---|---|
| active | taken on eligible lines |
| applied, suspended, closed, charged off or declined | not taken |
